_comment: chatwait P0: the chat wait-phase line. 9 new keys under a new top-level chatPhases namespace in all 20 dictionaries. Every value is an ARRAY of plain sentences with NO placeholders; the line cycles through the array while that phase is genuinely running. Array lengths must match across locales per key: 2 everywhere except chatPhases.attesting, which is 3. THE DEVICE POOLS (deviceLoading, devicePreparing, deviceThinking) MUST NEVER MENTION ENCRYPTION, A SERVER, THE CLOUD, A NETWORK OR AN UPLOAD: on-device inference never leaves the phone and a line saying otherwise is a false claim, asserted by chat-phases.test.ts. The cloud pools may and do. No line claims the model is verified or attested: the hot inference path never calls verifyAttestation. No em dashes anywhere, house rule for user-facing copy. Never edit the 20 dictionaries by hand.
